newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle light at $72 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle light at $72 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested. Feedlots reporting limited inquiry.
Sales reported on 100 slaughter steers and 100 heifers; 300 head confirmed for the week to date.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 72.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 72.00.
Wk to Date - 300 Week Ago - 109,200 Year Ago - 15,400
